card.name: Endings of meter- and Bot- words
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a split word, mainly -ing or -ed after "meter" (metering, metered) and "tero" after "Bot" in the name Bottero. Also the word " letter" after "a" or "their own".

modes.label: meter + ending
modes.description: The -ing or -ed ending after "meter" in metering device or metered-dose.

modes.label: Bottero name
modes.description: The "tero" ending of the scholar's name Bottero in citations.
modes.example: Jean Bot<<tero>>. Religion in Ancient Mesopotamia

modes.label: The word letter
modes.description: " letter" as a noun after a or own, in historical writing.
modes.example: she wrote a<< letter>> to Higginson beginning, Are

card.writes: It pushes toward unusual word-start pieces and away from endings like -ered and the word letters, with no clear theme.
card.plain: It fires on the closing piece of a few split words, like metered, Sloan-Kettering and Bottero, and on the word letter.
